answer.title: PV inverter OUEST1-INV04: Cable Degradation and Short-Circuit Risks
answer.synopsis: The PV inverter OUEST1-INV04 at Centrale PV Ouest-1 faces critical failure modes including cable degradation and short-circuit, which account for over 38% of the equipment's failure-related costs. The equipment experiences a higher incident rate compared to the site median, with 38 incidents versus 31.5, although severe incidents are slightly below the site median. Immediate actions should focus on thermography inspections and electrical integrity tests to identify and mitigate wiring issues, complemented by regular cleaning to prevent contamination.
